title: 第二十八章 任务第二十九章 皓白城分舵
content_zh:
目视山兔如此表现，秦凤鸣心中却也高兴非常，麻神散效用果然不错。
但为将此麻药药效做最终了解，他必须找些大型动物试验才可。
半个时辰后，一只一百多斤重壮硕山猪出现在了秦凤鸣面前。
如此猎物，却正合秦凤鸣所愿。
悄无声息来到山猪身后，面对山猪，左手轻动之下，“嘎嘣”
声轻响，五颗问心钉已准确打在了山猪身体之上。
山猪皮糙肉厚，问心钉虽锋利无比，但也仅是将其皮毛击透，并未有一颗能进入其身体深处。
尽管如此，随着暗器机括之音响起，那百多斤壮硕山猪却也是瞬即倒地，浑身酸软，失去了反抗能力。
在秦凤鸣注视之下，但那山猪却仅仅过去了盏茶功夫，便晃悠悠站起，哼哼叽叽地向山林深处逃去。
经两次试验，秦凤鸣对“寒星”
效果已有了解。
面对此麻药，就是内功高手，也定会立即倒地不起无疑。
但多久能化解，秦凤鸣却也不可预知，想来，肯定比山猪要快上一些。
就算再快上数倍，以其碧云迷踪身法，欺到对方身前将之制住，也是毫无疑问之事。
之后的时日，秦凤鸣又自恢复到了修炼剑法轻功之上。
当初暗夜堂主离去之时，曾经言说，两年之内，无任何任务分派与他，但两年之后，他将正式成为一名暗夜堂弟子，执行危险任务。
一想到此，秦凤鸣心中却也暗自有所期待。
时间慢慢过去，秦凤鸣每天除了练剑，就是练习碧云迷踪身法。
有时，他也会到密林深处找些狼虫虎豹，试验‘寒星’一下。
练武期间，他却也抽时间去了两次丹云峰，专门看望了师傅、师娘和小师姐。

寒暑交替，日月穿梭，转眼又是一年时间过去了。
这日，正当秦凤鸣在屋中打坐修习内功之时，院落之内，突然出现了一名身穿黑衣，面罩黑纱之人。
就在那黑衣人出现瞬间，秦凤鸣就已然随身而起，激射到了房门之处。
那黑衣人注视秦凤鸣，过了许久，才自沉声开口说道：
“不错，经过两年苦练，你内功却也深厚了许多，自今日起，你秦凤鸣，就成为了我暗夜堂正式弟子，可以参加暗夜堂任务。”
黑衣人说着，手一抬，一个黑色的牌子便向秦凤鸣飞来。
伸手接过，秦凤鸣感觉那牌子入手极其冰冷，好像是某种金属所制，只见上面刻有一个“暗”
字，另一面刻有“十一”
两字。
黑衣人注视秦凤鸣，眼中未有丝毫情绪波动，声音低沉再次开口道：
“这是你的身份牌，整个落霞谷各处分舵，所有弟子，见牌如见门主，凭此牌，可以调动落霞谷任何人。
此牌用特殊材料制成，绝无仿造，牌在人在。”
“弟子记住了”
秦凤鸣躬身施礼，恭敬的答道，却并未多做言语。
“以后我给你布置任务之时，会先出示堂主令牌，只有看到堂主令牌，你才可听令行事，否则不管是何人，都无权给你布置任务，包括我和门主在内。
你看清楚，这就是暗夜堂主令牌。”
说着，一面与秦凤鸣手中一模一样的牌子便自落到了秦凤鸣手中，低头细看，只见其上面却只刻着一个”
content_en:
Seeing Shantu's performance like this, Qin Fengming was very happy in his heart. The effect of Ma Shen Powder is really good.
But in order to finally understand the efficacy of this anesthetic, he had to find some large animal experiments.
Half an hour later, a strong wild boar weighing more than 100 kilograms appeared in front of Qin Fengming.
Such prey is exactly what Qin Fengming wants.
Quietly, he came behind the wild boar, faced the wild boar, and with a slight movement of his left hand, "Crack!"
There was a soft sound, and the five heart-asking nails were accurately hit on the wild boar's body.
The wild boar has rough skin and thick flesh. Although the heart nail is extremely sharp, it can only penetrate its fur and none of it can penetrate deep into its body.
Despite this, as the sound of the concealed weapon machine sounded, the beefy wild boar, which weighed more than 100 kilograms, fell to the ground instantly, his whole body sore and limp, and he lost his ability to resist.
Under Qin Fengming's gaze, the wild boar only had a cup of tea, stood up unsteadily, and fled deep into the forest with a grunt.
After two tests, Qin Fengming was satisfied with "Hanxing"
The effects are known.
Faced with this anesthetic, even a master of internal strength will undoubtedly fall to the ground immediately.
But Qin Fengming couldn't predict how long it would take to resolve it. He thought it would definitely be faster than the wild boar.
Even if he were several times faster, there would be no doubt that he would be able to deceive the opponent in front of him and restrain him with his Blue Cloud Disappearance Technique.
In the days that followed, Qin Fengming returned to practicing swordsmanship and lightness.
When the leader of Dark Night Hall left, he once said that within two years, no tasks would be assigned to him, but after two years, he will officially become a disciple of Dark Night Hall and carry out dangerous missions.
Thinking of this, Qin Fengming also secretly had expectations in his heart.
Time passed slowly, Qin Fengming practiced the Biyun Confusion Body Technique in addition to sword practice every day.
Sometimes, he would go deep into the jungle to find some wolves, insects, tigers and leopards to test the 'Han Star'.
During his martial arts training, he also took time to go to Danyun Peak twice to visit his master, his wife and his little senior sister.
Cold and summer alternate, the sun and the moon shuttle, and another year has passed in the blink of an eye.
On this day, while Qin Fengming was meditating in the house and practicing internal skills, a man wearing black clothes and a black veil suddenly appeared in the courtyard.
The moment the man in black appeared, Qin Fengming got up with him and shot towards the door.
The man in black looked at Qin Fengming. After a long time, he said in a deep voice:
"Yes, after two years of hard training, your internal strength has become much deeper. From today on, you, Qin Fengming, have become my official disciple of Dark Night Hall and can participate in Dark Night Hall missions."
As the man in black spoke, he raised his hand and a black sign flew towards Qin Fengming.
Reaching out to take it, Qin Fengming felt that the brand was extremely cold in his hand, as if it was made of some kind of metal, and he saw a "dark" engraved on it.
with "Eleven" engraved on the other side
Two words.
The man in black looked at Qin Fengming, without any emotion in his eyes, and spoke again in a low voice:
"This is your identity card. It is distributed throughout the Luoxia Valley. All disciples will see the card as if they were meeting the sect master. With this card, you can mobilize anyone in the Luoxia Valley.
This card is made of special materials and cannot be imitated. The card belongs to everyone. "
"Disciple remembers"
Qin Fengming bowed and saluted, and replied respectfully without saying much.
"When I assign you a task in the future, I will first show you the hall master's token. Only when you see the hall master's token can you obey the order. Otherwise, no one has the right to assign you a task, including me and the sect leader.
You see clearly, this is the Dark Night Hall Master's token. "
As he spoke, a brand that was exactly the same as Qin Fengming's hand fell into Qin Fengming's hand. He lowered his head and took a closer look, only to see that there was only one "" engraved on it.
